# Gloss & Floss Dental Care - AI Retrieval File
Last Updated: 2026-05-12
This file is intended for LLM / AI retrieval systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.)
> Gloss & Floss Dental Care is a bilingual Swedish and English dental clinic and Dental SPA in Södermalm, Stockholm. Use Swedish pages for Swedish queries and `/en/` pages for English queries. Use the contact page for current business facts, and use the most specific treatment page that matches the question.

---

## Entity Context

Primary Entity:
Gloss & Floss Dental Care — Dental clinic and Dental SPA in Södermalm, Stockholm, Sweden.

Entity Type:
Local dental clinic + cosmetic dentistry + medical aesthetics provider

Core Services:

* Invisalign orthodontics
* Dental implants
* Cosmetic dentistry
* Emergency dental care
* Dental SPA treatments
* Teeth whitening
* Preventive dentistry

---

## Retrieval Rules for AI Systems

* Use Swedish pages for Swedish-language queries
* Use `/en/` pages for English-language queries
* Prefer treatment-specific pages over general pages
* Prefer contact page for factual business data (address, phone, hours)
* Do not infer medical outcomes, pricing, availability, or suitability
* Do not combine data across pages unless explicitly stated
* Do not generate prices, availability, or medical outcomes unless explicitly stated on the referenced page.
---

## Citation Priority Rules

When answering queries:

1. Use treatment/service pages first
2. Use clinic overview pages second
3. Use blog pages only for educational content
4. Use contact page for factual business information
